mapper.sql: BUSINESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, ORG_NAME, ORG_TYPE, BUSINESS_REG_NO, PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS, DESCRIPTION, APPROVAL_STATUS, REJECT_REASON, APPROVED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM BUSINESS ORDER BY CASE APPROVAL_STATUS WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CREATED_AT DESC, BUSINESS_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE BUSINESS SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED', REJECT_REASON = NULL, APPROVED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE BUSINESS SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, APPROVED_AT = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG ( REVIEW_LOG_NO, ADMIN_MEMBER_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO, ACTION_TYPE, REASON, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{adminMemberNo}, 'BUSINESS', #{businessNo}, #{actionType}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
